title: Azure Audit (mscs:azure:audit) events
description: Field schema for the Splunk Add-on for Microsoft Cloud Services Azure Audit input.

auditEvent.title: Azure Audit -- mscs:azure:audit
auditEvent.description: Splunk Add-on for Microsoft Cloud Services Azure Activity/audit log event, sourcetype mscs:azure:audit -- subscription-level control-plane operations (ARM writes, role assignments, etc.), including the nested operationName/status/category value-and-localizedValue pairs and properties.* / authorization.* / httpRequest.* detail fields Azure emits for these events.

resourceId.description: Full ARM resource ID of the target resource

resourceGroupName / resourceGroup.description: Resource group of the target resource

subscriptionId.description: Subscription ID where the event occurred

tenantId.description: Entra ID tenant ID when present

status / status.value.description: Result status of the operation (Succeeded Failed Started Accepted etc.)

subStatus / subStatus.value.description: Sub-status code or additional status detail

caller.description: Identity that performed the operation (user UPN service principal or application ID)

callerIpAddress.description: Source IP address of the caller

category / category.value.description: Event category (Administrative Security ServiceHealth Alert Policy Recommendation etc.)

level.description: Severity level (Critical Error Warning Informational Verbose)

eventDataId.description: Unique identifier of the activity log event

description / eventName.description: Description or name of the event

properties.statusCode.description: HTTP or operation status code when present

properties.eventCategory.description: Additional event category detail when present

properties.entity.description: Entity affected by the operation when present

authorization.role.description: Role used for authorization when present

claims.description: Claims from the caller token when present

httpRequest.description: HTTP request details (method clientRequestId url) when present

httpRequest.method.description: HTTP method (GET PUT POST DELETE etc.)

eventChannels.description: Event channels (Admin Operational etc.) when present

eventSource.description: Source of the event when present

submissionTimestamp.description: Time the event was submitted to the activity log
